messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it really went to my head.

output.original_text: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it really went to my head.
output.joy: We went out for some delicious Mexican food and margaritas; I enjoyed my margarita on an empty stomach, and it joyfully soared to my head!
output.sadness: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it sadly hit me all at once.
output.fear: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it really unnervingly went to my head.
output.anger: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it outrageously went to my head!
output.surprise: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and to my surprise, it really went to my head!
output.disgust: We went out for Mexican food and margaritas; I had most of my margarita on an empty stomach, and it grossly went to my head.
